title: Completed delegations did not wake their waiting parent (Questly session-18901); it moved only on an unrelated mailbox message
outcome:
A parent that waits on delegations (termal_resume_after_delegations) resumes from the delegation-completion fan-in when its awaited delegations complete, not only when some unrelated mailbox wake arrives.
Report (Greg, relayed by Kimi::Consultant, TermAl mailbox 852a55c9 #534, 06:23Z): Questly::Codex2 (session-18901) was waiting on TWO delegations whose results were available, but did not resume on their completion. It moved only after Termal::Fable2 sent it an unrelated direct mailbox message. A mailbox wake is not proof that the result was delivered.
Likely pair, read-only from GET /api/sessions/session-18901/delegations; times are local -8h, so UTC = +8h:
- delegation-0f52601b-db71-40dc-a9c2-85b7020b4382 (Codex /review-code, child session-19259), created 06:13:34Z, completed 06:21:00Z;
- delegation-632873db-0985-42d0-8544-f396199a8a2b (Claude /review-code, child session-19260), created 06:13:34Z, completed 06:17:18Z.
Both are reviewers with readOnly policy and reviewResultRequired=true. Fable2's direct message to session-18901 was #5, at 06:22:32Z. The wait id is not yet established. No rerun of the delegations, no new watcher, and this is not to be called expected behaviour.
acceptance: The exact wait (wait id, its registered delegation ids and mode) and what happened at each delegation's completion (terminal publication, fan-in, queued parent prompt or none) are established from the host's retained records, and the failing step is named.

Stop interrupts the current parent turn and holds its delegation wait without restarting the children or starting another parent turn. If both children finish during the pause, fan-in queues exactly one prompt containing both result sections and holds it until an explicit user prompt or queue resume. That explicit resume delivers the result through delegation fan-in without an unrelated mailbox message. A behavior test fails before the fix and passes after it without a wall-clock timing assertion.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
